sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The applicability alternatives are still incomplete: the first branch makes every IA/IA Super ship subject to the compliance checks, while the second branch permits only non-IA classes. A ship of class IA or IA Super whose constructionStageDate is on or after 1 September 2003 must be non-applicable and pass without the date, assessment, delivery, method, and deadline obligations. Replace the alternatives with an applicable branch requiring exactly one IA/IA Super iceClass, the required dates and permitted method, and the pre-1-September-2003/deadline checks, plus a non-applicable branch covering exactly one iceClass outside IA/IA Super or an IA/IA Super ship with constructionStageDate on or after the cutoff; do not let missing iceClass or missing constructionStageDate select the non-applicable branch.
